import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
const directory = '/tmp/a03-type-categories-optimized-validation';
const read = name => JSON.parse(readFileSync(path.join(directory, name), 'utf8'));
const compare = (before, after) => Object.fromEntries(['medianMs', 'p95Ms'].map(key => [key, {
  before: before[key], after: after[key], delta: after[key] - before[key], percent: (after[key] / before[key] - 1) * 100,
}]));
const before = read('baseline-existing-performance.json');
const after = read('candidate-existing-performance.json');
const summary = { scope: 'canonical category authority prerequisite, partial #2403',
  product: '892822c33016ad7502821e245716efbbf552a16d',
  proof: read('source-proof.json'),
  native: JSON.parse(readFileSync('/tmp/a03-type-categories-validation/native.json','utf8')).comparisons,
  browser: read('browser/report.json'),
  initialFailure: '96/97: preexisting malformed TypeDef flags now reject earlier at CILVT0001 instead of CILVM0001',
  performance: { iterations: 1000, samplesPerMode: 12, warmups: 3, rawSamplesTotal: 96, retainedRawSamplesAcrossBothProducts: 192,
    construction: compare(before.results.construction, after.results.construction),
    inheritedInterface: compare(before.results.inheritedInterface, after.results.inheritedInterface),
    localAlias: compare(read('baseline-local-alias-performance.json'), read('candidate-local-alias-performance.json')),
    newCategories: { baseline: read('baseline-categories-performance.json'), candidate: read('candidate-categories-performance.json'),
      note: 'Baseline has no category query/authority support. Candidate full cost is added capability, not an existing-operation comparison.' } },
  notes: ['All first attempts and chronological samples retained; no repeats to improve timings.',
    'No noise, causal, speedup, allocation-volume or peak-memory claim.',
    'No runtime backend execution support or full #2403/#2405 completion claim.'] };
writeFileSync(path.join(directory, 'summary.json'), JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2) + '\n');
console.log(JSON.stringify({ performance: { ...summary.performance,
  newCategories: { medianMs: summary.performance.newCategories.candidate.medianMs,
    p95Ms: summary.performance.newCategories.candidate.p95Ms, known: summary.performance.newCategories.candidate.known } },
  browser: summary.browser.engines.map(engine => ({ engine: engine.engine, version: engine.version, checks: engine.checks })) }, null, 2));
